translation.name: Nzryrngrkxtr Kc Ate Rut x Sam

content: Mevalu Kxnzmcpx Myaszlzle Mosis

Mz nzmu-krde lcde, kx mzlengeng x inwengeng, kcng tqkqle kz Gct, mz nzngini-krmu leplz kxnztr nedeng, na-aoti drtwrmu Jiszs. Murde rpiku kx nide menrpa ne Gct kxmyapxbz x Nardr Pris kc tqtu mzlirgu badr Gct.
Mevalu atutrle da amrlx kcng tqyrlqbz Gct bade mz nzmcpx-krde nide, da kc tqwai Mosis nzatutr-krde nzwz-krde mz nzwztr-krbzle mz lr ma nyz Gct.
Nzamrluengr Jiszs myaszlzle nzamrluengr Mosis. Murde takitrde nzamrluengr ncblo kc tqatulzle ma nyz Gct, namyaszlzle nzamrluengr krkc tqwzpxm mz ma lcde.
Murde leplz kxnzkqlung nzwzng mz ma nyz Gct, a' Gct kc tqwz-ngrde da amrlx.

Mosis atutrle nzwz-krde mz nzwztr-krbzle mz lr ma nyz Gct. X trngiu kxetu, a' nide txpwz kxnzawz. X nzwz-krde lc ngi rkx ngr nzwzkr Jiszs kalr, kc tqplzpx-kaile da kc napibz Gct mz leplz nedeng mz nibrde, mz nzycmnetr-krde Jiszs.

A' Mevalu atutrle da amrlx kcng tqyrlqbz Gct bade mz nzngini-krde Mrlxde kc tqaclve-angidrle lr ma nyz Gct. X nipegu lr ma nyzde nzmu natu-amqngiku mz nzbrtikr drtwrgu Kraes x mz nzlxngiti-krgu kx sa naprtrku mz nzlungr kxboi, navz nakrlzbzle mzli kc nabz-ngrgu.
Bzkq Apuamu Kxtrnzabrtrpwzlru Drtwrdr Mz Gct 3:7 Rlwx nqmq kr lr Jiu mz ‘Natq Ngr Nzaplxtqngr’ mz buk lc.
Mz nzkrlz-krmu kx Mevalu myaszlzle Mosis, na-aoti drtwrmu natqde. Da kc tqwai nzpikr Mqngrkxtr le kx, “Naxlramu natqde mzbq ka, mz nzrpi-krbzle bamu kx,

‘Bzkq nabzmu mqngipe, da kc tzwailr melrmqmung. Murde kxmule-esz' nzmc-zvzlr nzrkati-krbo da kxmrlzting badr, mz nzmnc-krdr mrkc lzke mz yiz kcng nzpnu-pwx, a' otablrkr badr x nzatalzlr ninge mz nzxpqbrlr-krdr ninge.’
Dekc tqngyati ngr drtwrnge nidr, murde nidr leplz kx nzvz-rbrng mz nabzdr x trnzvz-nqblqlru nqmq krngeng.
X mz nzangya-krmlr drtwrnge, sc tqesalzpex kx, ‘Trtxpnzngr nzprtr-krdr mz nzmnc-zpwxngr kc nakabo badr.’”
Mz nzmu-krde lcde, kx mzlengeng x inwengeng, aclvetioamu, murde nabzmu ma tqdrka'-ngrng x tqapuamu kxtrnzrlxngitiung, mz nzpxtxpx-krmu Gct kc tqrkabz nzlungr.
Apqtr-etramu drtwrmu mzbq ka tqlube-ngrnamu, murde ma narmu tqmqngi x alwx tqesabrtile nimu.

Murde nztwz-krgu da kxmrlzting amrlx kcng tqesalzngr Kraes mz nzaxvctr-krbzku bade, nzvzpxmqng mz nzlolvz-amqngi-krgu nzlxngiti-krgu nide, da kc tqwai mzli kc tqrlxngiti-ayrnr-ngrgu, nakrlzbzle nzbz-krgu.

Bzkq mrbrtr mz drtwrmu nzalvztrkr Nzryrngrkxtr kx mzbq ka narlrpx-lzbq-ngrbzmu mz Gct. Murde rpile kx, “Naxlramu natqde mzbq ka, mz nzrpi-krbzle bamu kx, ‘Bzkq narmu mqngipe, da kc tzwai melrmqmung, murde otablrkr badr.’”
X mc-kzku kx leplz kcng pwz tqmailzpxm Mosis Ijipt x tzxlrlr natq Gct, nidr lcng tzotablrng badr.
X mc-kzku kx leplz lcng pwz tzangyatibzlr drtwr Gct mz yiz kcng nzpnu-pwx x tzbzpxmqng lzke, murde nzale-zvzng alwx.
X krlzku kx leplz lcng pwz tqesalz-ngrbzle badr kx, “Trtxpnzngr nzprtr-krdr mz nzmnc-zpwxngr,” nidr lcng tzxpqbrlr-ngrdr nide.
Mz nzmu-krde lcde, trnzprtrpeung mz nzmnc-zpwxngr kc nakabz Gct badr, murde trnzabrtrpzlru drtwrdr bade.
